issue.title: bob-plugins docs:check URL gate: architecture.md:74 docs/develop/validation.md maps to missing /develop/validation/
issue.description:
## What fails

`npm run docs:check` in bob-plugins (bob-cli's strict docs gate run with bob-plugins as
the plugin mount) passes the strict Zensical build and then fails the published-URLs step:

```
urls: 1 broken URL obligation(s):
  docs/develop/plugins/architecture.md:74: docs/develop/validation.md -> /develop/validation/: no built page for /develop/validation
docs-check: FAILED (published URLs, exit 1)
```

## Reproduction

- bob-plugins master c8da83f (clean local clone with origin set to
  https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-plugins), bob-cli docs cache at e5f5108:
  `bash scripts/docs-check.sh` fails exactly as above.
- Same failure on the rebased tree b1a655a (intention-card commit on top of c8da83f).

## Root cause

bob-plugins `docs/develop/architecture.md:74` says ``…`docs/develop/validation.md`
describes the acceptance gates…`` as a code span. bob-cli's published-URL gate turns that
repo path into a site URL relative to the host docs root (`/develop/validation/`), but
bob-plugins' `docs/develop/` is mounted under `/develop/plugins/`, so the real page is
`/develop/plugins/validation/`. The source line and target page are unchanged; the
failure surfaced when the URL gate began checking this obligation.

## Fix direction

Replace the code span with a relative Markdown link to the sibling page (for example
`[Validation](validation.md)`) in bob-plugins, or teach bob-cli's URL-obligation mapper to
resolve mounted-repo doc paths through the mount prefix. Then rerun `npm run docs:check`.

## Other reports

bob-cli-nu.1 (note #3) and bob-cli-nh.7.1.3 each recorded this as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP.
